parameters.url:
={{
  $node["Config"].json["SUPABASE_URL"] +
  "/rest/v1/client_feature_integrations" +
  "?select=id,client_id,feature_id,is_active,config,features!inner(slug),clients(welcome_message,default_reply,closing_message)" +
  "&" +
  (
    $node["Code in JavaScript1"].json["platform"] === "facebook"
      ? "config->>pageId=eq."
      : "config->>channelKey=eq."
  ) +
  encodeURIComponent($node["Code in JavaScript1"].json["channelKey"]) +
  "&features.slug=eq." +
  encodeURIComponent($node["Code in JavaScript1"].json["platform"]) +
  "&limit=1"
}}

call_ai_context
nodes.notes: AI Engine V1 cutover: calls the shared /api/ai-context endpoint (context + server-built OpenAI messages, replacing the legacy in-workflow prompt). Credential: 'AI Context Secret' (Header Auth) — the id below is a PLACEHOLDER, not a real n8n-issued id. After import, open this node and re-select the 'AI Context Secret' credential from the dropdown before activating the workflow.

nodes.name: openai_reply
